transformations.source:
INPUT Text

    PREPROCESS Text

    IDENTIFY all nouns
    IDENTIFY all pronouns

    FOR EACH Pronoun
        FIND the most likely matching noun
        LINK Pronoun to Noun
    ENDFOR

    OUTPUT Linked References
END
transformations.canonical:
FUNCTION unnamed_function ACCEPTS(Text)
        PREPROCESS Text

        IDENTIFY all nouns
        IDENTIFY all pronouns

        FOR EACH Pronoun
            FIND the most likely matching noun
            LINK Pronoun to Noun
        ENDFOR

        OUTPUT Linked References
    END
ENDFUNCTION
